correctness.rationale: Exact centered finite differences yield random orthogonal projector dynamics. Haar beta/idempotence gives E[SXS]=aX+b tr(X)I; the diagonal variance matrix is entrywise positive and Perron-Frobenius plus a rank-one resolvent show strict decay iff the unique scalar secular root inequality holds. Diagonal parameters at or above the pole force spectral radius above one; at equality a strictly positive left Perron vector gives no decay from any nonzero start. Strict convexity and majorization prove both attained endpoint spectra with equality cases. 2171 corroborating stdlib checks pass; finite testing alone is not relied on.
